title: Pan-Seared Smoked Prawns with Garlic Butter
description: Quick and flavorful French-inspired dish featuring succulent prawns seared to perfection with a rich garlic butter sauce.

ingredients.name: Kissed Smoked Prawns
ingredients.notes: Diced and used for added smokiness

instructions: 1. Rinse the king prawns under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
2. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add 1 tablespoon of Australian butter.
3. Add the king prawns and sear for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
4. Remove the prawns from the skillet and set aside.
5. In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of Australian butter.
6. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
7. Add the diced kissed smoked prawns and cook for an additional minute.
8. Deglaze the skillet with white wine, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
9. Add the freshly squeezed lemon juice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has slightly thickened.
10. Return the king prawns to the skillet and toss to coat with the garlic butter sauce.
11. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
12. Serve the prawns hot on skewers, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
